scope: Real OS advisory bootstrap lock only
review: Finite context required and thirty-second maximum lock wait enforced. Metadata never grants takeover.
Held descriptors retain the same inode; Close never unlinks. Actual child kill/reacquisition was tested.
Final symlink and hardlink targets are refused without modifying target data. Metadata diagnostics accept exactly sixteen decoded bytes or unknown.
Historical full-package failures used draft Docker files and are preserved, not reclassified as a passing combined candidate.
limits: Linux filesystem syscalls themselves are not preempted by context; local profile filesystem qualification remains necessary.
Enrollment must validate canonical ancestry and user ownership; this helper does not sandbox a hostile same-user process.
No Compose startup, NATS identity/readiness, native macOS or whole T07 acceptance is proved.
